reuse.why: Introduces getBulkBudgetCategories and folds the three N-month averages onto it, but setZero does not call it and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own row-by-row checks.

duplication.why: Removes the triple N-month-average copy, but pastes the new helper's exclusion SQL verbatim into setZero and adds a separate goal_def check in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The selection helper sits in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use it.

scope.why: Merges set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg (which went through setNMonthAvg) into a new setBulkNMonthAvg, a refactor beyond the requested exclusion rule.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule now exists as a helper, an inline SQL copy and per-row checks, so a future exclusion has to be added in three styles.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero inlines the same hidden/hidden-group/goal_def SQL instead of calling the new getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth filters on getBudgetData rows by hand.

disguised_duplication.where: The setZero query is a literal copy of getBulkBudgetCategories, not disguised; copyPreviousMonth's check is a plain parallel test.

one_place.where: Exclusion rule lives in getBulkBudgetCategories (N-month averages), a copied SQL query in setZero, and if-checks in copyPreviousMonth.
